faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the LRDE DRDO JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your willingness by email for the LRDE DRDO Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - ECE recruitment is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a BE/BTech or ME/MTech degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering with a first division and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the LRDE DRDO JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves Document Verification, a Written Test (if necessary), and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (LRDE DRDO), Bengaluru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - ECE post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 03/2026/JRF.
